description: This file defines a PHP class Wishlist in the namespace Opencart\uA0Catalog\uA0Model\uA0Account that manages customer wishlist operations such as adding, deleting, retrieving, and counting wishlist items. It extends a base system engine Model class.

classes.name: Wishlist
classes.description: A model class that handles customer wishlists, including adding, removing, and fetching wishlist data.

methods.name: addWishlist
methods.description: Adds a product to the customer's wishlist after removing duplicates.

methods.name: deleteWishlist
methods.description: Removes a product from the customer's wishlist, optionally specifying a product ID.

methods.name: getWishlist
methods.description: Retrieves all wishlist items for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTotalWishlist
methods.description: Returns the total number of wishlist items for a customer.
